image_description: A full-body side view of an American Bison standing on a dirt path with grass and a tree trunk in the background. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to smoother, lighter brown fur on the hindquarters. It has a large head with short curved horns, a visible beard, and sturdy legs ending in hooves.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, showing the characteristic broad shape and short, upward-curving horns typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct fringe of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the 'beard' description.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, consistent with the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and partially obscured by the thick mane/fur around the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the classic bison silhouette with a high, heavy front end tapering down towards the rear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is visibly shaggy and dense on the front half, creating a clear hump over the shoulders.
There is a visible transition where the fur becomes shorter and smoother on the rear legs and flank compared to the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively small in proportion to the massive head and body, fitting the species description.
All four legs are visible and appear sturdy. While the ground contact point is slightly soft due to resolution/shadows, the general structure and hoof shape are consistent with a bovid.
The tail is visible hanging down, appearing short relative to the body length, with a darker, bushier end.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and the connection of the head to the body, ensuring no limb fusion or extra limbs.
To check for edge bleeding between the shaggy fur and the background, which is a common AI artifact in hairy subjects.
To assess the naturalness of the fur texture and lighting consistency across the complex coat patterns.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency (shaggy vs smooth transition)
Boundary sharpness between dark fur and green background
Anatomical correctness of the shoulder hump
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy forequarters and the smoother hindquarters. AI models often struggle with this texture gradient, resulting in unnatural blending or 'melting' fur. Also, inspect the hooves carefully; while they look okay at a glance, low-resolution generation often results in 'mitten-like' feet rather than distinct cloven hooves. Verify if the tail connects naturally to the hindquarters without floating or merging into the leg.
